summary: Iter22 — SafeTradie Phase 3 Document Library (8 NEW doc types) validated end-to-end. Backend pytest 34/34 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter22_doc_library_phase3.py (~10.7s): GET /api/docs/types now returns exactly 16 types (8 Phase-2 + 8 Phase-3) across 6 categories; new field type widgets confirmed in registry (responsibilities on whs_mgmt_plan, asbestos_items on asbestos_register, test_results on ccew, plumbing_items on plumbing_coc); for ALL 8 new types — POST /api/docs/{type} returns doc_id+reference with correct counter_prefix (WMP/ASB/CCEW/PLB/HWP/EXP/LIFT/FPP), GET /api/docs?doc_type=X filters correctly with no _id, GET /api/docs/{id} returns doc, GET /api/docs/{id}/pdf returns application/pdf with %PDF magic and >5000 bytes (actual sizes 17-22KB); PATCH on lift_plan persists load_weight_kg=2750 and hazards[] with verification via re-GET; soft-delete (archived) -> hard-delete (404) works on hot_work_permit; auth enforced 401/403; unknown doc_type 404; Phase-2 regression: jsa + emergency_plan create+PDF still work. Frontend verified live on owner@safetradie.demo against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: /dashboard/document-library hub renders ALL 16 cat-type cards across all 6 categories (cat-type-{whs_mgmt_plan, asbestos_register, ccew, plumbing_coc, hot_work_permit, excavation_permit, lift_plan, fall_protection} all visible). Click cat-type-whs_mgmt_plan -> /dashboard/document-library/whs_mgmt_plan -> doc-list-page renders. New -> doc-form with field-responsibilities (new table widget) present. lift_plan E2E: filled field-site + field-load_description, doc-save fired, success toast 'Saved — LIFT-2026-0003' appeared, doc-pdf triggered an actual PDF download (19206 bytes). Spot-checked all 4 NEW table widgets render: asbestos_register/field-items, ccew/field-test_results, plumbing_coc/field-work_items. SWMS Library regression at /dashboard/swms loads with existing SWMS-2026-0001 row and zero .error elements. Phase 3 is good to ship.

issues: Date/datetime fields STILL use native browser <input type='date'/'datetime-local'> (visible mm/dd/yyyy --:-- -- placeholder in screenshot). Same call-out from iter20 + iter21 — recommend shadcn Calendar + Popover for visual consistency.

action_items: (Pre-existing) iter21 test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_doc_library.py has one assertion (test_docs_types_returns_8_types_and_categories) that hardcodes len(types)==8 — now fails because Phase 3 added 8 more types (16 total). Update that one assertion to == 16 OR drop it (the new iter22 test already covers it). All other 42 assertions in iter21 still PASS — functional behaviour unchanged.
(Nice-to-have) Replace native date/datetime-local inputs in DocumentForm FieldRenderer with shadcn Calendar (carryover from iter20/iter21).
(Optional, carryover) Wrap WeasyPrint write_pdf in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=30) inside docs_module.get_pdf for robustness on large registers.
(Optional) Add a /api/docs/stats aggregation endpoint so DocumentLibraryHub doesn't need to fetch every doc to compute per-category counts (carryover from iter21).
critical_code_review_comments: docs_module.py is now 1249 lines (was 735 in Phase 2). Strongly recommend splitting: docs_pdf.py (16 render_* functions + _common css), docs_registry.py (16 register_doc_type calls), keeping docs_module.py for routes + CRUD. File size guideline (>700 lines) is exceeded.

Phase 3 added 4 new field type widgets (responsibilities, asbestos_items, test_results, plumbing_items) but they share the same shape as existing 'attendees'/'checklist'/'contacts'. Consider a single generic 'table' field type with a columns:[{key,label,type}] schema, eliminating duplication in both backend (renderer if/elif chain) and frontend FieldRenderer. Future-proofs Phase 4+.

create_doc and update_doc still accept arbitrary dict body without per-type Pydantic validation — risk of typo'd field keys silently persisting (e.g., 'lod_weight_kg' on lift_plan would write a junk field). Suggest building Pydantic models from each spec['fields'] at registration time.
PATCH /docs/{doc_id} still does NOT bump version (carryover from iter21 — review_request did not flag this for Phase 3 but compliance audit requirements typically need version bumps).

Asbestos Register has 7-column items table (location/material/friable/condition/risk/control/accessible) but min payload only requires site_name — there is no validation that ACM register items contain at least 1 row before allowing save/PDF. Same for plumbing_coc work_items, ccew test_results. Empty tables produce a valid PDF with empty rows — likely acceptable for draft state but worth a soft-warning on transitioning to in_use/issued.
